objective: Screen a directly ablated four-anchor outer FFN at a tighter per-layer bound after the first sparse candidate exceeded the global logit cap by one BF16 quantum on one rank.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: All materiality, exact-zero, finiteness, hook, and parameter topology gates passed; rank 2 reached a 2.03125 correct-vs-projected maximum against the 2.0 cap.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Reduce the four-anchor outer gain from 1/2048 to 1/8192 and require a direct nonzero outer-FFN versus attention-only logit effect.

architecture.outer_ffn_placement: after the frozen MLP at decoder depth anchors 10, 21, 31, and 41
architecture.direct_ablation: Compare correct-state logits with addressed_moe_outer_ffn against the same state, carrier, gain, and MoE parameters under addressed_moe_controller so only the post-MLP branch changes.
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero recurrence is exactly projected-only in both paths; inactive layers are exact no-ops.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize a separately locked causal training run with 390 trainable tensors and the remaining open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and stop this outer-FFN branch.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, the unused strength holdout, or native generation.
